text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Happy "birthday," obviously... It seems
the
occasion has Ticket crying even
harder than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You think? Isn't she always like this? I
mean, she'll
cry for someone's birthday
even if she just met
them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Believe me, with how much time I spend
around
her, I can tell. She's crying
especially hard today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Just the other day you were in bed with a fever, but now here you are, turning one year older... I... Sniffle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Oh please, what are you trying to—hold
on... are
you crying for real?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
H-Hayahide! I get you! It just makes you
so
happy, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, gimme a break! What's wrong with
you two?!
